scope: Complete FORMAL exact off-shell epsilon^2 eta1 spatial Ward coefficient of frozen plane-longitudinal GE06+GE07+Lambda+NL0C+2eta NL0B action, including the corrected eta-rescaled bath q parent term, full original GE19 canonical independent L/shift row mapping and signed six-family source decomposition. This proves algebraic coefficient identity, not actual parent residuals on physical grids, a numerical structural tolerance or H4/Z21 science.
signed_Ward: W21=sum_i!=q(E_i00 F_i21,x +2 E_i10 F_i11,x+2 E_i11 F_i10,x)+4 sum_j E_qj,GE05,10 q_j10,x -d_x[B21]-d_t E_b21 =0
common_mapping: E_L21=(E_iso21+2 E_aniso21)/3, E_b21=E_shift21, E21=L21-S21 original GE19 RHS sign
source: W_source=sum_piece[H D_source_piece S_shift,piece+ik a(S_iso,piece+2 S_aniso,piece)/3], with FD8 GE06/GE07/Lambda/Y and FD4 GE05 M1/M2 frozen
parent: W_parent=sum_i!=q(E_i00 F_i21,x+2 E_i10 F_i11,x+2 E_i11 F_i10,x)+4 sum_j E_qj10,GE05 q_j10,x-d_x[L21 E_L00+2 L10 E_L11+2 L11 E_L10-b21 E_b00-2 b10 E_b11-2 b11 E_b10]
formal_identity: W_op + W_source + W_parent =0 IF all E21 linear operator/source and exact action parent mappings are from the same frozen action; do not assume W_op alone=0 or W_source alone=0
proof_gates: Pin all prior action/partial/canonical operator and source dictionary sources exactly.
Derive full off-shell formal mixed derivative from nonbath fields plus physical 2eta normalized per-node bath Ward, with background q_j00=0 and eta-independent homogeneous backgrounds.
Prove the exact extra +4 E_qj10 q_j10,x and absence of direct E_q20 q20,x for first-order physical H4 mixed coefficient; preserve exact plus sign and original 2 scale.
Separate the complete lower-parent/boundary remainder from the independent E_L21 and E_b21 rows without deleting it on shell prematurely.
Prove original GE19 isotropic+anisotropy row projection and the original E21=L21-S21 source sign at the mixed H4 coefficient.
Bind all six fixed actual H4F3b source families and original physical FD8/FD4 derivative scheme without modifying any source arrays or falsely requiring source-only Ward zero.
Provide formula and stop classification for unavailable physical parent Euler residuals and missing independent FD4/FD8 tolerance.

outcomes.FORMAL_COMPLETE_MIXED_WARD_LEDGER_PASS: All source-bound algebraic and exact sign/factor gates pass. Freeze full FORMAL continuum identity, then independent actual-grid all-parent residuals, boundary and preregistered FD tolerance remain necessary before H4 science.
outcomes.FORMAL_MIXED_WARD_LEDGER_UNRESOLVED: Freeze exact failed algebraic gate; do not run H4 science or fit residual.
